parts:
Dear list,
I am hiring a Postdoc Machine Learning to work with me on new analytical methods for sleep assessment from raw accelerometer data. The work could be an extension of GGIR, but it could also become a separate complementary tool then.

Please retweet, share on LinkedIn, or simply forward this link to anyone who might be interested. 

Sorry for spamming, but it is for a good cause :)
Thanks, Vincent
